summary: Frontend-only verification for logo-removal change on Myaccord. All 14 UI checks passed. Onboarding, Auth, and Home now display the 'Myaccord' TEXT wordmark with no logo tag anywhere. Role selection + Continuer navigation works, auth form (register/login/Google) renders, player login (leo@test.com/pass1234) succeeds, OFFRES feed loads, and all 5 bottom tabs (Accueil, Recherche, Direct, Messages, Profil) are present. No red-screen. Minor non-blocking RN web deprecation warnings observed (shadow* -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents) from library code; not related to this change.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow); props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Not from files under review; safe to ignore for this logo change but worth cleaning up when migrating shadows.

critical_code_review_comments: onboarding.tsx still imports Image from expo-image (used for role card BACKGROUND photos, NOT the logo). This is expected and correct - the request was to remove logo images only.
No remaining reference to myaccord-logo or logo.png anywhere in /app/frontend/app or /app/frontend/src.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Logo-removal change verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844) at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Player login flow works. Recruiter login and Google OAuth were not re-exercised (out of scope per review request); backend was previously green 84/84 in iteration_5.
